text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly trimming Stocks A, D and E at gains gave me satisfaction, but may have cut exposure before their prices could keep rising; I should trim based on outlook and portfolio risk, not just profit versus cost.","Selling Stock B at a 25.1% loss and later Stock D at a loss was painful, but holding solely to avoid realizing a loss is no better; I should reassess each position objectively and act when its prospects change.","After buying more A, C and D, my account rose sharply and then fell 5% in the latest period; I should monitor overall exposure and downside risk, not rely on recent gains or isolated stock decisions."]}
